description: Loads a published GearHost site from GearHost's servers and reports problems to fix: missing files and broken links on the site, external scripts/stylesheets that fail to load (e.g. a wrong CDN version), no mobile viewport tag, no <title>, images without alt text, http:// resources on an https page, images over 1 MB, contact forms that send nowhere, and leftover placeholder text (Lorem ipsum, example.com). Pass the site url (or token / name + project_key) and optionally a path. Works for GearHost-hosted sites only. JavaScript is not executed, so runtime script errors are not detected. Each issue has a severity (error, warning, info) and a suggested fix.

name.description: Alternative to url: site name (pair with project_key).

path.description: Optional page path to check on the site, e.g. "/contact.html". Default: the home page.

project_key.description: The project_key the named site was published with.

token.description: Alternative to url: the manage token returned by publish_website.

url.description: The site or page address, e.g. https://my-site.gearhost.io/ or https://my-site.gearhost.io/about.html.

name: check_site

ms.description: Time to load the page from GearHost, in milliseconds.

ok.description: true when no error-level issues were found.

title: Check site for problems
